title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5323 Highway N in Cottleville, Missouri as the "Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 5323 Highway N in Cottleville, Missouri, as the "Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a Missouri post office after Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 5323 Highway N in Cottleville, Missouri, as the "Lance Corporal Phillip Vinnedge Post Office." It is a naming change only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or its staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014, and the name took effect on that date.
